q3.summary: The bear case centres on BofA's Underperform call: negative sales growth through FY27, a 107% dividend payout ratio and a $24 target. Bulls point to low valuation (FinQL fair value $54.47) and Oppenheimer's Outperform rating with a $52 target.

facts.label: BofA downgrade
facts.detail: Target cut from $47 to $30 on Sep 25, then to $24 after the Oct 1 earnings report.

facts.label: BofA estimate cuts
facts.detail: Fiscal 2027 and 2028 EPS estimates cut by 11% and 12%.

facts.label: Greater China
facts.detail: Revenue decline in fiscal Q1 2027, cited by BofA as a driver of the downgrade.

facts.label: FY27 guidance
facts.value: Revenue down high single digits; adjusted EPS $1.15 to $1.35
facts.detail: Guidance reinforced BofA's view of a delayed recovery.

facts.label: Bull valuation
facts.value: Trailing P/E 17.2x; forward P/E 21.1x; dividend yield 4.6%
facts.detail: FinQL figures dated Sep 25, 2026; its fair-value model gives $54.47, or 51.3% upside.

facts.label: Consensus
facts.detail: 42 analysts polled by S&P Global; target range $19 to $94 (stockanalysis.com, updated Oct 14, 2026).
